# Decision Template (ADR)

> Copy this template into `docs/decisions/NNN-<slug>.md` when a discussion is
> approved. Follow the Format and Naming rules below.

## Naming

- **File**: `docs/decisions/NNN-<short-slug>.md`
- **Sequence**: NNN is the next available zero-padded number (001, 002, ...)
- **Slug**: short, hyphenated, lowercase identifier, e.g. `cache-strategy`

## Format

```markdown
# NNN. <Title>

- **Date**: YYYY-MM-DD
- **Status**: Accepted | Proposed | Deprecated | Superseded
- **Source Discussion**: `docs/discussions/DISC_NNN-<slug>.md`
- **Implementation Plan**: `docs/plans/pending/NNN-<slug>.md`

## Context

The problem being addressed, constraints, and relevant background.

## Decision

The chosen approach stated clearly and unambiguously.

## Alternatives Considered

Briefly list considered options and why they were rejected.

## Consequences

Positive and negative consequences of this decision.

## Verification

How to confirm the decision was implemented correctly (tests, checks).
```
